C0524.title: CCTV Exposes a Free Smartband Cash-on-Delivery Scam
C0524.summary: On October 9, 2018, CCTV's Focus Interview aired 'Fake Smartbands, Real Fraud'. The program reported that users who scanned a QR code and reposted messages promising a free branded smartband were drawn into a carefully designed cash-on-delivery scam. Police found that Gu registered Harbin Zinuo Trading Co., Ltd. to run the fraud, involving 658 suspects and more than 80 million yuan.
